e.title: ClauseGuard
e.summary: LangGraph 保单条款分析 agent：结论溯源到原文条款 + 自定义 MCP 检索
e.body: ClauseGuard 是 LangGraph agent：读取租赁合同、保险保单、ToS，把每个结论**溯源到具体条款**，带自定义 MCP 检索器与基准测试。对 RIAA：保单条款理解的 AI 实现——「结论可溯源」正是保险/法律场景的信任关键；与 [[llamaindex]]（RAG 编排）、[[mineru]]（文档解析）构成「保单文档 → 条款问答」链路，培训课可演示可溯源的条款问答。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库描述确认（LangGraph/条款溯源/MCP），未实测
e.summary_en: LangGraph policy-clause analysis agent: traces every conclusion to its source clause + custom MCP retriever
e.summary_hk: LangGraph 保單條款分析 agent：結論溯源到原文條款 + 自定義 MCP 檢索
e.body_en: ClauseGuard is a LangGraph agent: reads leases, insurance policies and ToS, tracing every conclusion back to its source clause, with a custom MCP retriever and benchmarked prompt/chunking strategies. For RIAA: an AI implementation of policy-clause understanding — traceable conclusions are exactly the trust requirement in insurance/legal scenarios; with [[llamaindex]] (RAG orchestration) and [[mineru]] (document parsing) it forms a policy-document-to-clause-Q&A pipeline, demoable as traceable clause Q&A in training sessions.
e.body_hk: ClauseGuard 是 LangGraph agent：讀取租賃合同、保險保單、ToS，把每個結論**溯源到具體條款**，帶自定義 MCP 檢索器與基準測試。對 RIAA：保單條款理解的 AI 實現——「結論可溯源」正是保險/法律場景的信任關鍵；與 [[llamaindex]]（RAG 編排）、[[mineru]]（文檔解析）構成「保單文檔 → 條款問答」鏈路，培訓課可演示可溯源的條款問答。
